corrections.reason: The 7th-order loop on ሎ was slightly broken in print and misread as ለ plus a quotation mark; Amharic syntax concluding the prodigal son's inner monologue requires the gerund ብሎ.
The Ge'ez enclitic particle ኒ (part of አንተሰኒ, 'and as for you') was visually misread as ጓ due to ink bleed.
